fields.reason: Unresolved arithmetic discrepancy, already recorded in AFTON_HITEC_12204L and AFTON_HITEC_12250: the components add to 14.5 while the premix is printed as 14.2. Four Afton documents (05/18, 08/18, 04/19, 2019 presentation) and the May-19 programme book print the same numbers, so the discrepancy is in the source, not a reading error. Proposal for HiTEC 12200 only: add an open-question entry that LINKS to the existing finding (no new conflict, no duplicate) and lists the four corroborating printings. Values are not corrected; the 10.3 + 4.2 route and the 14.2 premix are not treated as numerically interchangeable; the Aramco Prima Group II restriction stays attached to the '%wt' evidence.
